arxiv-2104-09738.title: Constraining Mixed Dark-Matter Scenarios of WIMPs and Primordial Black Holes from CMB and 21-cm observations
arxiv-2104-09738.creator: Hiroyuki Tashiro 1 and Kenji Kadota 2 1 Department of physics and astrophysics, Nagoya University, Nagoya 464-8602, Japan 2 Center for Theoretical Physics of the Universe, Institute for Basic Science (IBS), Daejeon, 34051, Korea
arxiv-2104-09738.description: Abstract We consider the dark matter (DM) scenarios consisting of the mixture of WIMPs and PBHs and study what fraction of the total DM can be PBHs. In such scenarios, PBHs can accrete the WIMPs and consequently enhance the heating and ionization in the intergalactic medium due to WIMP annihilations.

arxiv-2105-03980.title: Large k k topological quantum computer
arxiv-2105-03980.creator: Nikita Kolganov, Sergey Mironov, Andrey Morozov
arxiv-2105-03980.description: Abstract Chern-Simons topological quantum computer is a device that can be effectively described by the Chern-Simons topological quantum field theory and used for quantum computations. Quantum qudit gates of this quantum computer are represented by sequences of quantum ℛ \mathcal{R} -matrices.

arxiv-2209-00304.title: Unified formalism for the law of emergence from the first law of thermodynamics
arxiv-2209-00304.creator: Hassan Basari V. T, P. B. Krishna, Titus K. Mathew
arxiv-2209-00304.description: Abstract We derive a unified expansion law for our universe from the first law of thermodynamics on the apparent horizon, where entropic evolution depicts the emergence of cosmic space. The derivation advances a general form for degrees of freedom on the surface and bulk, which provides a natural generalization for the expansion law proposed by Padmanabhan.

arxiv-2401-11476.title: Finite solvable tidy Groups whose orders are divisible by two primes
arxiv-2401-11476.creator: Nicolas F. Beike, Rachel Carleton, David G. Costanzo, Colin Heath, Mark L. Lewis, Kaiwen Lu, Jamie D. Pearce
arxiv-2401-11476.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nicolas F. Beike, Rachel Carleton, David G. Costanzo, Colin Heath, Mark L. Lewis, Kaiwen Lu, Jamie D. Pearce. In this paper, we investigate finite solvable tidy groups. We classify the tidy { p , q } \{p,q\} -groups. Combining this with a previous result, we are able to characterize the finite tidy solvable groups. Using this characterization, we bound the Fitting height of finite tidy solvable groups and we prove that the quotients of finite tidy solvable groups are tidy.

arxiv-2404-11077.title: Sylow theorems for supergroups
arxiv-2404-11077.creator: Vera Serganova, Alexander Sherman, Dmitry Vaintrob
arxiv-2404-11077.description: Abstract . We introduce Sylow subgroups and 0 0 -groups to the theory of complex algebraic supergroups, which mimic Sylow subgroups and p p -groups in the theory of finite groups. We prove that Sylow subgroups are always 0 0 -groups, and show that they are unique up to conjugacy.

arxiv-2602-09007.title: GEBench: Benchmarking Image Generation Models as GUI Environments
arxiv-2602-09007.creator: Haodong Li 1,2 , Jingwei Wu 1 , Quan Sun 1,† , Guopeng Li 1 , Juanxi Tian 7 , Huanyu Zhang 5 , Yanlin Lai 1,4 , Ruichuan An 3 , Hongbo Peng 1 , Yuhong Dai 1 , Chenxi Li 6 , Chunmei Qing 2,∗ , Jia Wang 1 , Ziyang Meng 1 , Zheng Ge 1,∗ , Xiangyu Zhang 1 , Daxin Jiang 1 1 StepFun 2 South China Universi
arxiv-2602-09007.description: Abstract Recent advancements in image generation models enable the prediction of future Graphical User Interface (GUI) states based on user instructions. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on general domain visual fidelity, leaving evaluation of state transitions and temporal coherence in GUI-specific contexts underexplored.

pmc-11311136.title: Dexamethasone Long-Term Controlled Release from Injectable Dual-Network Hydrogels with Porous Microspheres Immunomodulation Promotes Bone Regeneration
pmc-11311136.creator: Weikang Xu, Weihua Huang, Xiayu Cai, Zhaohui Dang, Lijing Hao, Liyan Wang
pmc-11311136.description: Long-lasting, controlled-release, and minimally invasive injectable platforms that provide a stable blood concentration to promote bone regeneration are less well developed. Using hexagonal mesoporous silica (HMS) loaded with dexamethasone (DEX) and poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) (PLGA), we prepared porous DEX/HMS/PLGA microspheres (PDHP).

pmc-11447941.title: Shaping root architecture: towards understanding the mechanisms involved in lateral root development
pmc-11447941.creator: Kavya Yalamanchili, Joop E M Vermeer, Ben Scheres, Viola Willemsen
pmc-11447941.description: Plants have an amazing ability to adapt to their environment, and this extends beyond biochemical responses and includes developmental changes that help them better exploit resources and survive. The plasticity observed in individual plant morphology is associated with robust developmental pathways that are influenced by environmental factors.

pmc-11457218.title: Ecofriendly Filtration of Silver Nanoparticles for Ultrasensitive Surface-Enhanced (Resonance) Raman Spectroscopy-Based Detection
pmc-11457218.creator: Kevin
pmc-11457218.description: In this study, a widely used colloid of Creighton AgNPs (ORI, 1–100 nm, mostly ≤ 40 nm, ∼10 μg mL–1) was rapidly manipulated via tangential flow filtration (TFF) for highly reproducible surface-enhanced (resonance) Raman spectroscopy (SE(R)RS) experiments down to the single-molecule (SM) level.

pmc-11529281.title: Associations Between Supervisory Alliance, Medical Resident Distress, Burnout, and Self-Esteem
pmc-11529281.creator: Danielle L Terry, Prabhdeep Bajwa
pmc-11529281.description: IntroductionSupervision is considered a collaboration between a supervisor and supervisee and includes perceptiveness, responsiveness of the supervisor, a state of rapport, and specific learning tasks that allow the individual to work towards a goal. The alliance in supervision has been identified as a key ingredient of effective supervision, regardless of the type of treatment, population, or supervision model being used.

pmc-11655557.title: Synthetic dataset of ID and Travel Documents
pmc-11655557.creator: Carlos Boned, Maxime Talarmain, Nabil Ghanmi, Guillaume Chiron, Sanket Biswas, Ahmad Montaser Awal, Oriol Ramos Terrades
pmc-11655557.description: This paper presents a new synthetic dataset of ID and travel documents, called SIDTD. The SIDTD dataset is created to help training and evaluating forged ID documents detection systems. Such a dataset has become a necessity as ID documents contain personal information and a public dataset of real documents can not be released.

pmc-12723303.title: Electron-phonon interaction and superconductivity in the silicon-boron-carbon monolayers with high stability
pmc-12723303.creator: Jingjing Wang, Panlong Kong, Zaifu Jiang, Dingmei Zhang, YuKai You, Bei Hu, Shihua Fu, Yue Fang
pmc-12723303.description: SummaryRecently, considerable attention has been given to the exploration of superconductivity in low-dimensional materials. By employing unbiased structure search and first-principles calculations, we systematically investigate the structural and electronic properties of the predicted two-dimensional (2D) compounds SiBC4, SiBC6, and SiB4C in the monolayer limit.

uslaw-usc-t33-s702j2.title: 33 U.S.C. § 702j–2 — White River Levee District; rights-of-way; drainage facilities; flowage rights; acquisition by local authorities; protection of United States from liability for damages
uslaw-usc-t33-s702j2.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t33-s702j2.description: United States Code, Title 33 (Navigation And Navigable Waters); Chapter 15 (Flood Control). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Chief of Engineers, under the supervision of the Secretary of the Army, shall at the expense of the United States Government construct a system of levees substantially in accordance with general plan shown on map designated as sheet numbered 1 entitled “Tributary Levee.
